integration_issues.issue: Axios 401 gate_required interceptor triggers window.location.reload() on EVERY 401 gate_required, including those fired by useEffect(warm) at App.js:117-121 which calls recipesApi.list('mikilab') on mount regardless of adminOk state. Also AuthContext /api/auth/me on mount hits gate. Result: fresh visitors are stuck in an infinite reload loop — the AdminGate keypad gets reset every ~2s before the user (or automation) can enter 1985. Cookie mikilab_gate is never issued because verify never completes.

rca of the issue: React runs useEffect hooks even when the render returns early via `if (!adminOk) return <AdminGate/>`. App.js:117-121 fires `recipesApi.list('mikilab')` on mount unconditionally; also useUser/AuthContext fires /api/auth/me. Both hit gated endpoints. Response 401 {detail:'gate_required'} is caught by the api.js interceptor which unconditionally removes `mikilab_admin_unlocked` and schedules `window.location.reload()`. Since the flag was already absent on fresh visits, the reload is spurious — it just re-runs the same cycle, causing an infinite loop. Reproduction: (1) clear cookies + localStorage, (2) load https://edit-33.preview.emergentagent.com, (3) network tab shows /api/auth/me and /api/recipes returning 401 gate_required every ~1.5s in a reload loop; keypad dots stay empty. Suggested fix: guard the reload — only reload if the flag WAS set (kicked-out scenario). Example: `const was = localStorage.getItem('mikilab_admin_unlocked') === '1'; localStorage.removeItem('mikilab_admin_unlocked'); if (was && !window.__gate_reloading) { ... reload }`. Alternative fix: skip the warm-up + /me useEffects when `!adminOk`.
action_items: CRITICAL: Fix axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js — do NOT reload if the mikilab_admin_unlocked flag wasn't set (fresh visitor case). Suggested: `const was = localStorage.getItem('mikilab_admin_unlocked') === '1'; localStorage.removeItem('mikilab_admin_unlocked'); if (was && !window.__gate_reloading) { window.__gate_reloading = true; setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 50); }`. Without this fix, every fresh visitor is stuck in an infinite reload loop before they can even enter the master PIN.
Consider also gating App.js:117 `warm()` and AuthContext /me behind `adminOk` to avoid unnecessary 401s at the gate screen.
